text_block_list.text:
The day of Nakayama Festa's Make Debut has 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, for the debut race. Who is the 
Umamusume to watch?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Who told you to say your trainee's name, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I can't say you're completely 
wrong.

Caught up by her wry smile, I recalled the 
moment we arrived at the racetrack.

It happened when I was sending data on the 
upcoming race entrants to Nakayama Festa's 
device—

text_block_list.name: Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Umm, is that singer's kid racing today? 
Let's get a photo first—wait...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Camera! On that girl! The one with the 
hat!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: —It's that "Nakayama Festa."

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text: (Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
"This is her first real race, isn't it? 
Now then, I wonder which way her racing 
career will turn..."

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
If you're truly aiming for the world 
stage, your debut race should be a walk in 
the park...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa, well now.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
For now, the public eye is on us out of 
mere curiosity rather than popularity, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's nice to be paid attention to. 
And not just by the reporters, either.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah... Of course, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
So that's the one from the rumors... The 
one who picked a fight with El-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"You've never run on official turf before, 
have you? ...Let's see what you've got."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, such burning gazes nonstop. 
It's only my debut race, you know? 
Heheh..."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Man, it gives me the shivers...!
choice_data_list: (I see, so that's what this is about...)
(I see, so that's how it is...)

text_block_list.text:
A tense, prickly pre-race atmosphere. 
Nakayama Festa drew the hostile glares of 
all the competing Umamusume entirely onto 
herself.
(Bee-bee-bee-bee-beep-beep!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "...Oi, you. Your phone."

On the smartphone brought out, an event 
titled 'Meet near Spectator Stands / GATE 
10' was displayed.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't panic over every little thing. If 
you're not composed, you can't look cool.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm the only one standing in the paddock 
anyway. Feel free to wander off wherever 
you want, got it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, yeah.

And so, after seeing Nakayama Festa off, I 
headed to the rendezvous point. There—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I'm so sorry! Did I keep you waiting?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Huh, please raise your head! You didn't 
keep me waiting at all...!

This woman was Nakayama Festa's former 
homeroom teacher. I actually owed her a 
few favors.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, was that old footage 
of Festa helpful to you, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
For now, what I managed to give them was 
the footage of that girl running on the 
freestyle course.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
There wasn't really anything other than 
some things from when I attended my 
father's racing school, but...

She had her own personal footage of 
Nakayama Festa's past races. I had 
borrowed a copy of it.
choice_data_list:
It's been extremely helpful for my 
research!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Really? Ah, thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Still, coming to a racetrack for the 
first time in years... it feels kind of 
refreshing."
choice_data_list: Let's go watch Nakayama Festa right away.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Yes. I look forward to working with you!

And when the two of them moved to a spot 
where they could see the paddock—

text_block_list.name: Journalist
text_block_list.text:
...Is Nakayama Festa coming out soon? 
Maybe I should contact the desk.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...! Did you hear that? Looks like the 
journalists on-site are super focused on 
Festa too!
choice_data_list:
Less like attention and more like 
curiosity, maybe...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Even if that was your initial reason, 
that's totally fine! As long as you get to 
know the power of the Festa!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Trainer-san, you signed a 
contract with Festa because you truly 
believed in her ability, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Fufu, indeed. Ah――... What a relief.
(Waaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! That over there is Festa, 
isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, it's really true... To think that 
girl enrolled at Tracen Academy and made 
it to the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: I wonder... how is she running now?

Together with her, deeply moved by her 
pupil's growth, I watch over Nakayama 
Festa.

While contemplating our next steps and 
deciding on what path Nakayama Festa 
should take to reach the world stage after 
her debut race――
